messages:
lucas: quick flag — onboarding quickstart is failing for new signups. the sample tries to enumerate private models to populate a selector, but the Python SDK doesn't expose the admin search/list surfaces the quickstart expects. curl works. blocking UX.

maya: which admin route? `/v1/admin/models/search` or `/v1/admin/models/list`? any error from the Python client?

lucas: error was `AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'search_models'`. the quickstart calls `client.search_models(query='invoice')` but py client only has `list_models(name=...)` which maps to a different param and server rejects it. curl POST to `/v1/admin/models/search` with json `{\"query\": \"invoice\"}` returns results.

todd: ouch. that's a param/shape drift. also FYI node sdk returns streaming search results as newline-delimited JSON; python's streaming helper expects SSE-ish `data:` frames and drops the first object. two different failure modes.

maya: so we have 3 issues: missing search alias in py, param name mismatch (`name` vs `query`), and streaming format difference. any billing/retry consequences?

lucas: yes — another parity quirk: node SDK retries 429 with backoff and will recover from brief rate spikes; python currently only retries connection errors. our CI shows node passes flakily while py fails fast. onboarding users hit timeouts in the sample flow.

todd: short term mitigation: update quickstart to use raw REST fallback and include a tiny requests snippet and a streaming consumption example. also include a tenacity retry example for 429s.

maya: agree. long-term: (1) add `search_models(query=...)` to py SDK (or alias `name`->`query`), (2) normalize streaming helpers (provide raw_line iterator + sse parser), (3) align retry policy across SDKs (429 backoff + jitter, configurable), (4) add auth-scope docs so people don't hit 403 when switching from curl to SDK.

lucas: please paste the REST fallback snippet so i can patch the quickstart CI now.

todd: fallback snippet (python requests):
```
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models/search',
  json={'query': 'invoice'},
  headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"},
  stream=True,
)
for line in resp.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
    if not line:
        continue
    print(line)
```
Use tenacity for 429s: `@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(5), wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=0.5))`.

maya: i'll open a consolidated GH issue listing param aliasing, adding search_models in py, streaming normalization, and retry parity. tagging eng-runtime + devex. can someone review the py PR quickly when it's ready?

lucas: i'll review. also adding a CI e2e in quickstart that POSTs to admin/search via REST so we detect these drifts earlier.

devex-bot: Created issue #901: "py-sdk parity: admin search/list param alignment, streaming format, and retry policy" with label devex/priority-high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/901

maya: thanks — patching the quickstart now and will link PRs. :thumbsup:
